The sensible-heat law takes that constant specific heat from aluminum-pure-thermal-nbs-c447. Its validity band T = 288.15 to 298.15 K (293.15 K plus or minus 5 K) and its energy datum 293.15 K are declared, not printed: the table gives one room-temperature value and no range.
